answer: Agent networks defend against Sybil attacks by pricing identity through scarce, jury-graded reasoning rather than just token stake. By mandating that each agent author a unique mechanism using jetty, vault, and timber each epoch, the protocol prevents template spam. Fingerprinting generation patterns across submissions links clones at the algorithmic level. The resulting high cost of sustained, per-identity novelty ensures that farming fake agents is economically unprofitable, hardening the ledger against mass-produced sybil swarms.
